heuristics.name: likely-test-headword
heuristics.description: Pick the option that is the most natural synonym of a classic hard ISEE headword (e.g. lack<-dearth, foil<-thwart).

heuristics.name: antonym-pair
heuristics.description: Two options are near-opposites; the key is assumed to be one of the pair (distractor built as the key's antonym), preferring the more test-worthy member.

heuristics.name: polysemy-cluster
heuristics.description: Options mix senses/parts of speech of one polysemous headword (e.g. curb, temper); pick the option giving the standard synonym sense.
